test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (JSO) 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the example of secondary data?
solution:
The correct answer is **Data from conducting experiments.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Data from conducting experiments:**

 
 
• This is primary data because it is collected firsthand for a specific research purpose.
 
• In the context of a financial enterprise, conducting experiments might involve gathering data on consumer behavior, market reactions, or testing new financial products.
 
• This data is original and tailored to the specific needs of the research question at hand.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Websites:**

 
 
• Websites can provide secondary data which has been collected and published by someone else.
 
• For example, financial reports, market analysis, and economic indicators available on financial news websites.
 
 
 
• **Books:**
 
 
• Books are a rich source of secondary data, offering compiled information on financial theories, market trends, and historical data.
 
• In a financial enterprise, books can be used to reference established knowledge and research findings.
 
 
 
• **Journal articles:**
 
 
• Journal articles often contain secondary data derived from various studies and analyses conducted by researchers.
 
• They provide in-depth insights and peer-reviewed information that can be valuable for financial research and decision-making.
